title: How Kona.m became Kona.m
lede: There was no master plan. There was training, an Excel sheet, AI, bikes, rooms, an island, and a suspicious number of side quests.
current_posture: Finished enough to let you in. Not finished enough to stop changing.

phases.label: THE RETURN
phases.title: Back to triathlon
phases.summary: One of my favourite persons recently inspired me to get back into triathlon. The first problem was simple: understand the comeback and start moving again.

phases.label: THE SHEET
phases.title: Excel, naturally
phases.summary: The comeback needed a tracking sheet. It was supposed to stay a tracking sheet. This is the last point at which the scope behaved normally.

phases.label: THE SIDE QUEST
phases.title: AI, bikes, then 3D bikes
phases.summary: AI became a way to learn by making. Bikes became the subject. Then the bikes became three-dimensional objects that could be inspected, compared and rebuilt.

phases.label: THE PROOF OF CONCEPT
phases.title: CanyonMuseum
phases.summary: The first bounded world was a bike museum: a proof that browser-native 3D, engineering history, evidence and playful interaction could coexist. CanyonMuseum was the working project identity, not a claim of brand affiliation.

phases.label: THE NAME OUTGREW THE ROOM
phases.title: Kona.m
phases.summary: The project stopped fitting inside a single-brand museum. The museum became one part of a broader triathlon world: identity, machines, places, stories, progression and experiments. Kona.m became the master product identity.

phases.label: THE WORLD
phases.title: Rooms, places and 141 reasons to look twice
phases.summary: The museum became a world. Race places, rooms, Finds, stamps, keys and the 140.6 idea turned browsing into exploration. The Point Six became the reminder that not everything worth finding should be handed over immediately.

phases.label: THE SYSTEM
phases.title: Make the weird things reusable
phases.summary: As athlete rooms, partner ideas and new worlds appeared, the architecture had to stop rediscovering itself. Shared room, asset, story, provenance and release contracts became part of the product.

phases.label: NOW
phases.title: Finished enough to let you in
phases.summary: Kona.m is deliberately not presented as finished-finished. The current goal is to make each useful piece clearer, more reliable and more alive, then learn what deserves to exist next.

principles.title: Curiosity before certainty
principles.body: The next useful puzzle can be enough. The whole map does not need to be visible first.

principles.title: Useful before impressive
principles.body: 3D, AI and cinematic presentation are depth layers. The core experience must still make sense without them.

principles.title: Truth stays attached
principles.body: Editorial interpretation, reconstructed objects, verified facts and future concepts should not blur into one another.

principles.title: Independent by default
principles.body: Referenced races, athletes and brands do not imply sponsorship, endorsement or affiliation.

principles.title: Local-first where possible
principles.body: The first experience should work without forcing registration, tracking or a cloud account.
